relations.rationale: The club meeting for its weekly session sets the scene where clock testing sounds would occur.
The meeting time and weather are unrelated to who drove the minibus.
The meeting occurring has no bearing on the relative arrival order of Ivo and Jude.
Tables being set up is unrelated to who the team captain is.
Tables set up suggests preparation consistent with the room filling with clock-testing sounds, but these are largely independent events.
Table setup has no bearing on the arrival order of Ivo and Jude.
Nell's role as captain has no bearing on the sound of clocks being tested.
Nell being team captain supports her having the authority/role to promise scheduling a follow-up meeting.
Nell bringing a folder of puzzles is unrelated to whether the trip from the other campus went smoothly.
Bringing old tournament puzzles is unrelated to how the next match will be scored.
Nell's puzzle folder has no bearing on whether Tess arrived before Jude.
Bringing puzzles doesn't determine whether games remained unfinished by session's end.
Nell bringing puzzles is unrelated to her promising to schedule a follow-up meeting.
The sound of clocks being tested is unrelated to Tess arranging pieces by color.
Tess unpacking her set carefully directly leads into and supports the detailed action of arranging pieces by color.
Tess unpacking her set is unrelated to the advisor checking attendance.
Tess's unpacking behavior is unrelated to Xavi's height.
Tess arranging chess pieces has no bearing on the age difference between Ivo and Jude.
Tess's piece arrangement is unrelated to Jude's eagerness to try a new variation.
Tess checking for missing pawns is unrelated to the scoring system used for the next match.
